description: Fires only in the opening (about the first 2-7 plies, mostly when I moved first and the opponent has just replied), when the opponent's latest stone is in column 0, 3, 5 or 6 and no stones are in column 1. Opponent stones in columns 1 or 2 switch it off, as does any stone of mine in column 1. Stacks of three in columns 0 or 5 drive it highest. It is silent in midgames.
effect: None measurable: forcing it high or off moves column probabilities by at most about 1 point on opening positions and about 4 points in a midgame.
notes: Best dev F1 0.735 (P 0.725, R 0.746, AUROC 0.869), sim share 0.18. Hand-weighted additive score over stone columns, last-move column and ply, set from act minimal pairs (ply-2 sweep of all 49 openings, ply-4 single-stone swaps). Simple 'opening + last col in 0/3/5/6' gave F1 0.45. It behaves like a token/column tally rather than a clean board concept, with order-dependent interactions (my col-1 stone gates it off). F1 is just over 0.7, but the rule is an additive fit with exceptions, so confidence is medium. Steering effect negligible. Synthesis 5,0,5,0,0,0 = 3.854 beats dev max 3.660.
